findings.triggered_by: Each person named on the application for the Account and anyone else authorized to use the Account in any way is jointly and severally liable for all amounts due on this Account.

findings.plain_language_explanation: If you add anyone as an authorized user, they can run up debt and you're 100% responsible for paying it all, even if you didn't make the purchases.
findings.user_impact: Since you carry balances, adding authorized users could worsen your debt if they overspend.

recommended_actions.action: Set spending limits for any authorized users through your card company
Monitor account weekly and remove authorized users who overspend
Consider prepaid cards instead of adding authorized users to your account
